notes: B2B SaaS checkout microservice. Handles payment initiation, order creation, and inventory reservation. Downstream dependencies: payment-gateway, inventory-service, notification-service, postgres, redis. Assessment date: 2026-03-21.

structured_logs.comment: Logs are JSON via pino. request_id and trace_id are included. Card numbers are redacted but customer email is still logged in plaintext on checkout errors.

metrics.comment: Prometheus metrics exposed on /metrics. Latency histograms and error counters are present for all critical paths. Exemplars not yet enabled — prom-client upgrade pending.

distributed_tracing.comment: OpenTelemetry Node.js auto-instrumentation active. traceparent propagated to payment-gateway and inventory-service. No manual spans around checkout workflow steps (payment authorisation, inventory lock, order creation).

slo_sli.comment: SLOs are defined in a Notion doc for availability and p95 latency. No formal error budget policy or tooling to track budget consumption. Alerting is not wired to burn rate.

alerting.comment: Alerts exist for raw error rate > 5% and CPU > 80%. No burn-rate alerts. On-call team reports ~12 pages per week, many of which are noisy infrastructure alerts with no actionable signal.

correlation_ids.comment: X-Request-ID is generated at the API gateway and propagated into checkout-service logs. It is NOT forwarded to payment-gateway or inventory-service, so cross-service correlation requires manual trace lookup.
